review.changePolicy: Any fixture, expected result, diagnostic code/pointer, hash, or performance baseline change must be reviewed separately from inventory changes.

methodology.parseProjection: One measureParsePerformance call reads the supplied UTF-8 fixture and invokes the public parseDocument API once. Counters traverse the returned JSON value and normalized model/projection graph: each value, object key, and edge is one deterministic operation; allocationCount counts reachable object/array containers exposed by those outputs.
methodology.conversion: Not measured: no conversion worker or external converter is involved in this parser/projection gate.
methodology.render: Not measured: no UI renderer is involved in this parser/projection gate.
